Oriented allelic log-likelihood ratio vs balanced

Source: R/caller_core.R
ll_allelic.Rd

bb_loglik(nA, n, f, rho, eps) - bb_loglik(nA, n, 0.5, rho, eps) for molecule votes nA of n (one vote per molecule). Two-sided (default) takes the better of f and 1 - f (the orientation of the counts is unknown or may be wrong). With several f the best LLR over the grid is returned (the attenuation-aware 1:0 / 2:0 term over f_att). Rows with n = 0 (or NA) give 0; without any vote rho is not used (it may be NA). The scorer uses llr_20 at f = 1 - eps, llr_21 at 2/3, llr_31 at 3/4 and the grid form over f_att.

Usage

ll_allelic(nA, n, f, rho, eps = 0.02, two_sided = TRUE, per_row = FALSE)

Arguments

nA

votes for haplotype A

n

total votes

f

major-haplotype fraction of the state (scalar or a grid)

rho

beta-binomial overdispersion (null fit, fit_allelic_null())

eps

allele error floor

two_sided

max over f and 1 - f

per_row

f is one expected fraction per row (length 1 or length(n)), not a grid: the LLR of each row at its own f (NA results also give 0). Used by the tumour mode (0.5 + a * (f_state - 0.5) per row).

Value

numeric vector (length of n)
